title: The Uncharted Summit
author: Beatrix Thornbury
blurb: Zephyrine Iversen, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
